correctness.rationale: For characteristic p>3, equal first three power sums of ordered triples imply equality of their elementary symmetric polynomials by Newton identities, hence equality of their multisets. Character orthogonality with normalized curve measure and unnormalized counting target makes ||Ef||_6^6=N^3 F3(theta), where F3=6-9s2+4s3. Algebra yields A_q-F3=(5-4/q)(s2-1/q)+(4/q)[(q-2)e2-3q e3]. The normalized Newton inequality e3<=2(q-2)e2^2/(3(q-1)), combined with e2<=(q-1)/(2q), makes the extra bracket nonnegative; equality only for a point mass or uniform theta. A point mass gives the exact quotient 5-4/q, proving global optimality, not just local curvature. Inspected actual CHECK.py; independently checked exact rational boundary ratios for q=5,7,11. A finite grid does not prove the unrestricted finite-field theorem.
